title: Zod v4: .min()/.max() after .transform() is a type error (ZodPipe)
signature: Property '(min|max)' does not exist on type 'ZodPipe
conditions: String fields trimmed with a custom transform before length checks.
root_cause: In Zod v4 .transform() returns ZodPipe, which has no string methods.
resolution: Use z.string().trim().min(1).max(n); put checks before any transform.
evidence: m3-02: coder fix round timed out; manual fix passed check.sh m3-02-manual (2026-10-25).
limitations: Only for built-in string checks; custom transforms still go last.

title: Zod v4: JSON Schema is z.toJSONSchema(schema), not schema.toJSONSchema()
conditions: Passing a schema to Ollama's structured output (format).
root_cause: Model used a method form that does not exist in Zod v4.
evidence: m3-03: rewritten provider passed check.sh m3-03-manual and a live qwen2.5:7b call (2026-10-25).

title: Imported a package that is not installed (abort-controller)
conditions: Timeouts or HTTP in Node code.
root_cause: Training habit: npm packages for things Node 24 has built in.
resolution: Use built-ins: fetch, AbortSignal.timeout(ms), crypto.randomUUID, node:fs, node:crypto. Never add dependencies.
evidence: m3-03: rewritten with AbortSignal.timeout, passed check.sh m3-03-manual (2026-10-25).

title: Relative imports must end in .ts and types need import type
signature: TS2835|TS1484|needs an explicit file extension|type-only import
conditions: Any new TypeScript file importing project modules (nodenext, verbatimModuleSyntax).
resolution: import { x } from "../dir/file.ts"; import type { T } from "./schema.ts".
evidence: m3-05: 4 TS2835 errors; manual rewrite passed check.sh m3-05-manual (2026-10-25).

title: DB rows, res.json() and JSON.parse are unknown: cast or validate before use
signature: TS18046|TS2339: Property '[^']+' does not exist on type '(\{\}|unknown)'
conditions: Reading SQLite rows or parsed JSON in strict TypeScript.
root_cause: Model treats unknown values as typed objects.
resolution: const row = db.prepare(sql).get(id) as { data: string } | undefined; err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err).
evidence: m3-08: coder's lint loop kept failing on these; manual parse.ts passed check.sh and a live parse (2026-10-26).

title: Prompt templates contain JSON brackets: replace only the given [keys]
root_cause: A generic [..] regex treated JSON examples as placeholders and threw; folder name is requierements, files are .md.
resolution: Replace each given "[key]" literally; read requierements/<name>.md.
evidence: m3-04 fix: all three prompts load and fill (2026-10-25).

title: Coder invents fields when the schema it uses is not in its context
signature: TS2339: Property '[^']+' does not exist on type
conditions: New file that uses types from another module the coder cannot see.
root_cause: Not established. Suspected: aider gets only the target file and spec (m3-05 used b.entries, b.skills[i].name).
resolution: Give the defining schema in the context package (what this knowledge layer does). Verify on the next coder run.
evidence: m3-05 original: invented b.entries; m3-05-kb (context truncated): still invented; m3-05-kb2 (context visible): used the real BankSchema fields.
limitations: Verified on one task; the model still makes typing mistakes with schema-derived types (omit).

title: SQL syntax error near CREATE after a spec with a SQL comment
conditions: Coder copied SQL from a spec that contained a -- comment.
root_cause: Not established; the comment is a suspect, the coder's own edit may be the cause.
resolution: No comments inside SQL in specs; every statement ends with a semicolon inside db.exec.
evidence: m3-07: worktree check failed; manual edit passed check.sh m3-07-manual.

title: mini-swe-agent fix rounds never converged (20 min each)
conditions: Every mini fix round in M3.
root_cause: Not established. Suspected: no num_ctx (Ollama default context), so the task scrolled out; no step limit.
resolution: Phase 0 sets num_ctx=8192 and step_limit=40. Confirm with ollama ps CONTEXT during a mini run.

title: aider's repo map (4,096 tokens) pushes requests past the 8k window; Ollama drops the read-only context
conditions: aider with default --map-tokens on qwen2.5-coder:14b at num_ctx 8192; read-only files plus spec plus whole-file output.
root_cause: Not established, strongly supported: m3-05-kb sent 8.7k, 12k, 14k, 16k tokens against an 8,192 window; the output ignored rules and types that were in the dropped read-only files (.js imports, Bank never imported, invented entries).
resolution: Run aider with --map-tokens 0 (the context package replaces the repo map), keep each request under num_ctx, and flag any request above it as a failure.
evidence: m3-05-kb (2026-10-26): 7 type errors with a complete context package; evidence in .agent-logs/runs/m3-05-kb/. Re-run m3-05-kb2 on llama.cpp (16k window, --map-tokens 0): every request inside the window (6.3k-14k), invented fields and .js imports gone, 5 errors left, all ordinary typing slips.
limitations: Verified on one task (m3-05). The lint loop still grows history per round.

title: Setting fields on a value typed from Schema.omit({...}) fails: the omitted fields are not on that type
signature: Property '(approved|meta)' does not exist on type
conditions: Model output typed from BankSchema.omit({approved, meta}) and then mutated to add those fields.
root_cause: Model treats the omitted type as the full type.
resolution: Build a new object: const bank: Bank = { ...result.value, approved: false, meta: {...} }.
evidence: m3-05-kb2 (2026-10-26). | m3-05-fb: in the initial context package; the task passed with no such error (not a repair round, so not promoted).

title: run-plan.sh dropped the plan's shared rules: task specs never contained them
conditions: Any plan with rules written above the first '## task:' line (plan-m3.md: imports, Zod, profile directory).
root_cause: The awk splitter wrote only each task's own section into its spec.
resolution: run-plan.sh copies the preamble into every spec under '## Shared rules (apply to every task)'.
evidence: m3-05-fb passed every check but hard-coded ./profile instead of JOBOPS_PROFILE_DIR, a rule only in the plan preamble; split test now shows the rules in each spec (2026-10-26).
limitations: Only plans run through run-plan.sh; hand-run specs must include their own rules.

title: An untyped empty array can be inferred as never[]: pushing to it fails with TS2345 ... 'never'
signature: TS2345: Argument of type '[^']+' is not assignable to parameter of type 'never'
conditions: An empty array literal whose element type TypeScript cannot infer (e.g. in an object literal or returned before use), then .push(...).
root_cause: No type annotation on the empty array.
resolution: Annotate it: const issues: string[] = []; (or the element type the function returns).
evidence: m3-05-ab (2026-10-26): the only error left after the first attempt; the repair round repeated it because no known fix matched; escalated by the feedback loop. | resolves escalation m3-05-ab (2026-10-26, incorrect_implementation): check failed (repeated failure signature 35ce206a8950 (the changed strategy did not change the outcome))
limitations: Observed once; promoted to verified only when a repair round that is given this fix passes.
